name: anilist-mcp-server
description: MCP server for the AniList GraphQL API — search and browse anime/manga, characters, staff and studios, and manage your own AniList lists.
long_description: MCP server for AniList. Reads (search/details/genres/tags/recommendations/threads/activity/public user data) call the public AniList GraphQL API and require no credentials. Personal-list and social tools (add/update/remove list entries, favourites, follow, posting/deleting activity or threads, update_user, notifications) act on the authenticated user's own AniList account and require a user token; without one they return an actionable error. Works with any MCP client.

anilist_client_id.title: AniList Client ID
anilist_client_id.description: Optional. From an app registered at anilist.co/settings/developer — needed to use login_anilist.

anilist_client_secret.title: AniList Client Secret
anilist_client_secret.description: Optional. Paired with the Client ID above — needed to use login_anilist.

anilist_access_token.title: AniList Access Token
anilist_access_token.description: Optional. A pre-obtained AniList access token, as an alternative to running login_anilist.

anilist_oauth_port.title: OAuth Callback Port
anilist_oauth_port.description: Optional. Localhost port for the login_anilist callback (default 8082) — change if that port is taken.

anilist_token_store.title: Token Store Path
anilist_token_store.description: Optional. Overrides where the AniList access token is persisted (defaults under the OS config dir).
